title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shed -1.15% in Pre-market Trade
text:
February 5, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shed -1.15% in Pre-market Trade 
Today Apple shares fell -1.15% in pre-session trade. In last week, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) got banged up, as it faced its worst losses in nearly two years. Apple stock tumbling more than 10%, from its high just two weeks earlier. 
Head of sales and trading at Cowen, Dvaid Seaburg, says Apple Inc. (AAPL) has not turned rotten. More than that, this pullback presents an opportunity to “buy” the stock, he says. 
“At these levels I think it’s kind of a no-brainer,” Seaburg told CNBC’s “Trading Nation” on Friday. 
David Seaburg said, as of the end of December, if look at, how much cash they have on hand, the world’s largest company had $77.15 billion in cash, and in short-term investments. The company said, last year, that it had just over $252 billion in cash held overseas. That number should grow once Apple delivers on its pledge to repatriate billions from outside the United States. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s stock on Friday traded at beginning with a price of $166.00 and when day-trade ended the stock finally slumped -4.34% to reach at $160.50. Analyst’s mean target price for AAPL is $189.78 while analysts mean recommendation is 1.90. Stock value has moved between $127.38 – 180.34 in last one year. 
Analyst’s ratings play a very important role in outlining a stock’s performance. Let us check out how analysts have ranked AAPL based on current scenarios. Stock has got OUTPERFORM rating from 14 analyst(s) whereas last month 17 analyst(s) have given outperform rating. SELL rating has been given by 0 analyst(s) and 16 analyst(s) given BUY rating to the stock. Company fiscal year is ending in September and analysts’ consensus recommendation is Outperform for AAPL and estimated EPS for next quarter is 4.44. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) yearly performance is 24.87% and net profit margin is 21.10%. Annual EPS Growth of past 5 years is 7.90%. The current share price indicates that stock is -10.88% away from its one year high and is moving 25.61% ahead of its 52-week low. About Jasmin Chavez
